# Meet, Greet, Depart

## Greet someone

If you want to greet someone, say,

> Ayubowan

That's a Sri Lankan greeting saying 'May your lifespan increase'.

It is a very formal greeting; thus should not be used for casual greeting.

## Say Mama Yannam

If you need to depart, say,

> Mama Yannam

That's a Sri Lankan way of saying "I'll leave now".

It is a casual statement.
